tools.name: search_wavedash_docs
tools.description: Search official Wavedash docs (docs.wavedash.com) for browser game development, SDK integration, engines, CLI, upload, and publishing. Use this for any Wavedash question when the exact page is unknown. Returns ranked pages with paths, URLs, and excerpts. Read-only and unauthenticated.

tools.name: get_wavedash_doc
tools.description: Fetch a full Wavedash docs page as Markdown by path or docs.wavedash.com URL, for example sdk/achievements, engines/unity, or cli/configuration. Use this when the user wants to see a Wavedash docs page or when exact SDK, CLI, or config details are needed. Only docs.wavedash.com pages can be fetched.

tools.description: Validate wavedash.toml contents for Wavedash CLI config issues (missing game_id or upload_dir, entrypoint repeating the upload_dir, absolute paths, engine sections). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_wavedash_docs, get_wavedash_doc, validate_wavedash_config · Private data: validate_wavedash_config · Public sink: wavedash_implementation_planner, search_wavedash_docs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_wavedash_docs, get_wavedash_doc, validate_wavedash_config · Private data: validate_wavedash_config · Public sink: wavedash_implementation_planner, search_wavedash_docs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
